name: Flintlock musket
notes: Origin at the lock plate center, barrel along +Z, butt toward -Z, lock on the +X side. Joint cock 0...50 degrees swings the hammer forward onto the frizzen.
parts: walnut full stock with wrist swell and cheek relief
brass butt plate, trigger guard, side plate and three barrel bands
1.0 m round blued steel barrel with brass sights
flintlock with frizzen, pan, cock, flint in leather jaws, mainspring and screws
ramrod in pipes and sling swivels
style: 1775 British Land Pattern musket, oiled walnut, aged brass, blued steel with wear.
summary: 1775 British Land Pattern flintlock musket, 1.45 m: walnut full stock, blued steel barrel, brass furniture, flintlock with flint in leather jaws, ramrod and sling swivels.
